promptText:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: ONE complete same-room Rana Kaname mother artwork for 在场, exactly 1536 x 1024.
Image 1 is the approved apricot COMPLETE CHARACTER MOTHER and is the edit target: it owns the exact pose, anatomy, face, costume, objects, supports, camera and framing. Image 2 is the matching clean-room rain LIGHTING REFERENCE ONLY: borrow its coherent complete environmental illumination and exterior time/weather, not its absence of a person. Return the complete room WITH the one original Rana, not an empty room. This is independently re-lit full-scene artwork, not a recolor/filter and not a new composition.

LOCK GEOMETRY: Preserve the exact camera, furniture scale, perspective, framing, complete four-sided window, lake/campus silhouette, left rear small desk/chair, bookshelves/books/plants/drawing, right writing desk/chair/existing lamp, bench/pillows/throw, rug, floorboards, actual props and every furniture foot. Keep original boundaries and clear central-left living space. No crop, zoom, furniture or character movement, new object, white gradient or cleared blank left wall.

LOCK IDENTITY: Keep the exact youthful original Rana Kaname / 要楽奈 from BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!! in Image 1, same short silver-white bob and soft straight bangs. Her OWN RIGHT iris is gold-yellow, her OWN LEFT iris clear blue; do not exchange sides when turned. Preserve natural youthful proportions and same loose black outer top, white sleeves, white shorts and footwear state. Fine youthful Japanese-anime linework/soft cel shading, natural silver hair and skin. No adult-model face, chibi, cat girl, sensual framing or body emphasis.

PLANNING invariants from the ACTUAL Image 1: keep Rana seated sideways on the existing RIGHT desk chair, both hips supported by its cushion, torso upright in the same gentle half-turn and gaze back toward the visitor. Preserve the exact two separate knee/shin/ankle chains and BOTH complete lace-up boots grounded on the floor. One hand holds the small cream paper slip lifted near the desktop; the other remains by the pocket notebook on the desk. Keep the actual notebook, placed paper and held paper in their original positions and contacts. Do not convert this into a writing pose, leaning study pose, new gesture or different facial expression. The lifted paper belongs to her hand; the notebook stays on the real desktop.

RAINY NIGHT / 夜雨暖金: Rebuild the complete room as one coherent quiet rainy night, matching Image 2. The ENTIRE exterior window is deep navy rain-clouded sky over the same mountain/lake/campus outlines, delicate rain on glass, a few distant warm window dots and subdued lake reflections. No sun, sunset, stars or moonbeam. The ONE existing cream desk lamp stays in place and is the primary warm indoor light, with LOCAL down-and-out amber illumination on desk, nearby chair, bench, character, and a limited floor area, fading gradually. Remove all hard daytime leaf silhouettes and rectangular sunbeams from left wall and floor: do not retain them as golden patterns. Window adds only low diffuse cool-blue fill at curtain, hair and bench edges. Left shelves/flowers/desk stay legible in soft low reflected fill, not a second spotlight. Floor remains dry matte honey-brown, no wet interior, golden mirror or wide orange spotlight. Preserve natural skin, black/white clothes and silver hair rather than a global filter.

Keep the exact understated, curious and self-possessed Rana expression from Image 1. Weather is not an instruction to make her sad, sleepy, smiling broadly or perform generic caring; do not add tears, a care-smile, cat, matcha, pet or decorative narrative. Shared light must physically agree across character, papers, cushions, curtain, walls, furniture and floor, including contact shadows; preserve readable support. All original hair, hands, clothing, feet and complete boots remain within the same canvas with the original margins. No anatomy repair or pose redesign, no extra/missing/fused limb, floating support or sticker halo.

ONE uninterrupted naturally inhabited room. Natural plant colors stay local, no green cast. No UI, readable text, arrows, divider, split scene, collage, labels, watermark, logo, extra person or character. No full-image color overlay, translucent tint, black vignette or painted blank panel. Return ONE finished complete 1536 x 1024 mother image.

designerObservation: Personally inspected complete generated original: held paper, desktop notebook, exact turned chair, hips, independent knees and two grounded boots retained. Night window is coherent navy rain with distant lights; daytime leaf silhouettes and sun rectangles removed. One local desk lamp provides warm light on Rana and nearby floor while the left rear room remains readable. The original neutral direct gaze remains; no sadness or generic caring smile was introduced. No layers or runtime registration.
